Babcock Shares Climb on Earnings Beat, Push Into Drones

The company plans to invest more in mixed human and drone technology

By

Babcock BAB 9.38 % increase; up pointing triangle International Group shares jumped after the defense group reported higher-than-expected earnings and set out new growth plans focused on autonomous drones and national infrastructure security.

Shares climbed 8.15% to 10.55 pounds on Thursday morning and led the FTSE 100 index, which was trading 0.2% lower.
